_about: Bombardier CRJ100/200/440 Airport Planning Manual (CSP A-020, Revision 8), 00-02-01 Figure 2: page index 24, layers.py --mode image at scale 9.8308, clip 190,100,460,180 (front). The front view is drawn 1.7% larger than the side and plan (its printed 21.23 m span over the side's 24.38 m fuselage length), so it's rendered at the side's scale. Pixels of that raster, line centres; the right half as drawn (the aircraft's left side). The fin hides the fuselage's top at the centerline: the section starts where it shows. The nacelle is the inlet's outer ring.
